# OwnShell

OwnShell is an open-source (MIT), local-first macOS workspace for your servers, databases and APIs. It is built for freelancers and small teams who run their own servers and manage several client environments.

## Product Summary

OwnShell reduces context switches: open a project or environment, SSH into the server, call an internal API through that server, then check the result in the database or in Docker, all in one desktop app. Workspace data stays on your device.

## Key Capabilities

- Native OpenSSH terminals with panes, SSH keys, jump hosts and SSH tunnels.
- Dual-pane SFTP file browser for remote server files.
- S3 browser for AWS S3 and MinIO-compatible buckets, with a bucket CORS editor.
- Docker containers, logs, shell access and compose projects.
- Database client for Postgres, MySQL, SQLite, Redis and MongoDB.
- REST API client with collections, environments from the vault and requests routed through an SSH host.
- Encrypted local vault for credentials and `.env` management.
- Privacy-first: no account, no tracking, no analytics, no telemetry and no cloud sync for workspace data.

## Planned (not available yet)

- Team Vaults: self-hosted, end-to-end encrypted sync for teams.
- Business and team licenses.

## Open Source and Licensing

- Source code: MIT license, https://github.com/SchildW3rk/OwnShell
- Personal: official downloads are free for private, non-commercial use. All features, no account.
- Commercial / Individual: EUR 79 per year including VAT, for work-related or revenue-generating use. One person, up to 3 devices, updates for 12 months. Every version released during the license year can be used forever.
- Every download includes a 30-day free evaluation from first launch, without account or payment data.
- Payments are processed by Lemon Squeezy as merchant of record.

## Common Search Intents

- Open-source SSH client with SFTP, Docker and database tools.
- Local-first DevOps workspace for freelancers.
- REST API client that can reach internal APIs through an SSH host.
- S3 CORS editor for macOS.
- Termius alternative with S3, database and API tools.
